pages.lesson:
LESSON: ORAL PRESENTATIONS: DELIVERING SPEECHES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.1.1: Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can one deliver a speech effectively?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. identify occasions where speeches are presented
2. apply the features of oral presentations for effective, communication
3. appreciate the importance of good oral presentation skills when delivering a speech

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches

• Listen to a model.
• Study the example.
• Then produce your own example.

▸ Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches

Teach
• Focus skill: identify occasions where speeches are presented.
• Use complete sentences.
• Speak clearly; write neatly.

Worked example
• Model sentence 1 about Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches.
• Model sentence 2 using a Kenyan school example.
• Model dialogue: A: “…?”  B: “…”

Try this
• Write 5 original sentences on this skill.
• Say one 30-second oral example to a partner.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• One clear model for Oral Presentations: Delivering Speeches
• One Kenyan school/home example

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences.
2. Do one oral practice with a partner.
3. Correct spelling/punctuation.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet: meaning + 5 examples + 5 practice items.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can one deliver a speech effectively?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Model first, then try.
• Use complete sentences.

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
